## Activity

During July 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 348 captures. Activity covered the scheduled photography work for the month, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded total provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review. The report records the completed activity for the site and month without identifying any additional operational issue.

## Image quality

Of the 348 captures, 64 were marked ungradable during review. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 18.4. The result identifies the images that could not proceed through grading and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for July 2023. The report records the image-quality outcome without attributing it to a particular session or cause.

## Grading

Grading identified 69 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This measure summarises the interval for the reviewed work and indicates the central turnaround recorded for the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag describe the grading output associated with the 348 captures.
